idea-plugin.name: Canon Typing
idea-plugin.description:
Turns your typing into piano music. Every key you press plays the next beat of Pachelbel's Canon in D — a single note, or a whole chord at once — so your typing rhythm becomes the tempo.

Features

  • One beat per key press in the editor, with chords sounding in full.
  • Auto-Tempo (optional): when you type faster than a threshold, the music keeps a steady tempo of your choice regardless of how fast you type, and returns to one beat per key when you slow down.
  • Play Everywhere (optional): also plays in the terminal, plugin tool windows (such as chat panels), search fields and dialogs.
  • Load any MIDI file and type your way through it; notes that start together become one chord.
  • Built-in piano sound, synthesized in code — no sample files, no network access.
  • Works with IME input (e.g. Korean).

Usage

Open Tools | Canon Typing to enable or disable the plugin, switch Auto-Tempo and Play Everywhere, set the tempo, restart from the first beat, load a MIDI score, or play a test chord to check your audio output.

The built-in piece is a simplified arrangement based on the Canon's chord progression and melodic contour, not a transcription of the original score. Use a MIDI file for an exact score.
